colors.description: Colors the archetype's core cards span, in WUBRG order.

available.description: Every format whose active run published the method, compared or not; one the method scored no card in cannot be compared.

final_rank.description: Final standing when the source states one.

made_top_cut.description: Null when unknown or when the event had no top cut.

mainboard.description: The main deck, by name, without commanders.

position.description: The deck's place in its run, newest event first.

wins.description: Match wins reported in standings; with losses and draws, or null.

capabilities.description: Available capabilities; does not advertise planned functionality.

version.description: API artifact version from the Maven build.

archetype_count.description: Distinct archetype labels among the card's decks.

archetypes.description: Up to three archetypes playing the card, most decks first.

formats.description: In an overall run, the card's score in each format it combines, best first; null for a format's own run.

preview_printing.description: Null when the card is not in the active catalog.

price_usd.description: Cheapest USD market price among the card's playable paper printings; null without one or without published prices.

rank_change.description: Places gained since the previous run of this format; null without one or when the card was not ranked there.

score_per_usd.description: The selected output divided by the USD price; null without both.

series_decks.description: The card's decks in each trend period, oldest first.

share_delta.description: Meta share in the last trend period minus the first, as a fraction.

top_cut_count.description: Unknown when no deck with this card has a known top-cut result.

top_cut_lift.description: Top-cut conversion divided by the field's.

win_rate.description: Match points per game of the card's decks, 0-1.

win_rate_delta.description: Win rate minus the field's, as a fraction.

commanders.description: One card, or two for a partner pair, in label order.

label.description: The commander's name, or a partner pair's joined by " + ".

rank_change.description: Places gained since the previous run of this format; null without one or when the commander was not ranked there.

share_delta.description: Meta share in the newer half of the trend series minus the older.

top_cut_lift.description: Top-cut conversion divided by the field's.

win_rate.description: Match points per game of its decks, 0-1.

previous_score_run_id.description: The run rank changes are measured against.

prices_updated_at.description: When the source last refreshed the published prices; null without any.

view_counts.description: Matches per view under the same filters.

windows.description: Every published window of this format, latest end first, one run per source and window.

weight.description: How much the format counts in the overall grade, from its decklists.

active.description: Whether this is the run shown without a pinned run.

window_ends_before.description: Exclusive end of the cohort window.

components.description: The format runs an overall run combines, by format name; null for a format's own run.

field_top_cut_rate.description: Share of decks with a known result that made the top cut, 0-1.

field_win_rate.description: The field's match points per game, 0-1.

matches.description: Games reported in standings; null for runs that did not record them.

players_per_game.description: 2 for one-on-one formats, 4 for pods; null for older runs.

scored_cards.description: Cards the methods scored; ranks run up to this.

series_decks.description: The cohort's decks in each trend period, oldest first.

series_starts_on.description: First day of the trend series.

window_ends_before.description: Exclusive end of the cohort window.
